name: Robert Payne
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 2

items.text: Robert Payne is a writer and researcher running for Seat 2 on the Los Angeles Community College District Board of Trustees; he says he has taught at L.A. Mission College. He proposes offering more job-specific training and less expensive online textbooks. He supports ending student debt and identifies low enrollment growth as the district's main challenge.
